title: A Quiet Word
subtitle: hideTextUntilComplete
description: The card for this quest shows its name, its icon and its tasks -- and no
description at all, until it is completed. `hideTextUntilComplete` is for a quest
whose text would give away what it is asking for.
This description is the thing being withheld. If you can read this on the card
before finishing the quest, the flag is not being honoured.
